title: Explicit GitHub CLI auth preserves child-process isolation
summary: Forward existing GitHub token bindings only as explicit overrides for GitHub CLI commands.
reusable_steps: Forward existing GitHub token bindings only as explicit overrides for GitHub CLI commands
expected_outcome: The governed execution facade deliberately strips credentials from general child inheritance. A publishing command must explicitly forward the existing GH_TOKEN and GITHUB_TOKEN bindings to gh subprocesses only. Do not widen the global safe-exec allowlist or pass token values in command arguments or logs. Keep readiness and knowledge checks unchanged, and test both credential names plus unrelated-secret isolation.
